evidence.reason: The denylist workflow feeds `gitleaks git` a `git log` range. A PR can add a `.gitattributes` entry such as `credentials.txt -diff`, causing Git to emit a binary-file summary instead of the text diff for that path; gitleaks then cannot scan the prohibited content and the blocking denylist check can pass. The same exposure exists in the octopus-commit scan at line 105. This is an implementation defect in the existing fail-closed denylist behavior, not a request to enlarge scope. Adding `--text` to both `--log-opts` values in the template and regenerating the workflow is a routine compatible correction.
